# INDUS Web Agency

> Islamabad software studio for Rust and Python workflow automation, data pipelines, and web apps.

## Core services
- Rust & Python workflow automation, including AI calling agents and dialers
- Web scraping & data pipelines
- Web apps, CRMs & dashboards
